title: Prism Ray Geometry and Net Deviation
equation: A = r_1 + r_2,\quad \delta = i + e - A
equation_latex: A = r_1 + r_2,\quad \delta = i + e - A

variables.r_1: Angle of refraction at first face
variables.r_2: Angle of incidence at second face
variables.i: Angle of incidence at first face
variables.e: Angle of emergence at second face

assumptions: Triangular optical prism with planar non-parallel refracting faces
Ray coplanar with principal prism cross-section
validity_conditions: Universal geometric ray relation for transmission through any prism cross-section
common_misuse: Assuming minimum deviation formula \delta_m = (n-1)A applies to large-angle prisms
Confusing apex angle A with base angle
